ask: mkae a pol for the theme plz
sentence: A one-time group poll with three fixed theme options where each person gets one changeable vote, and any member can lock the top option so voting ends.
use_when: A group needs to pick a party theme from a short fixed list
Everyone should vote once and the most votes decides
Someone wants a final locked result after voting
A quick vote in a chat with a few people
dont_use_when: Members need to add their own options or write in answers
The vote needs a deadline, ranked choices, or multiple picks per person
The choice is about picking a date or time slot
